title: 2018 Volkswagen Golf GTI Collision Repair
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair completed collision repairs on a 2018 Volkswagen Golf GTI following a hit-and-run incident.
story: A 2018 Volkswagen Golf GTI arrived at Carcis Autobody Repair following a hit-and-run incident. Damage was concentrated on the front passenger side, extending across the front bumper, headlight assembly, front right fender, and side mirror housing.

Technicians marked damaged sections and teardown began by removing damaged exterior components to inspect hidden mounting brackets and body structures underneath. Replacement panels were fitted, test-aligned, and prepared for refinishing to match the original Metallic Dark Gray factory paint.
After painting and clear-coating, the bumper cover, headlight, and trim were reinstalled. Final quality checks confirmed proper panel gaps and headlight operation before vehicle delivery.
